title: Specmetry source add result v1
description: Output of `specmetry source add <path> --json` (Agent-facing). Registering an already registered, not removed path changes nothing and returns the existing source with created = false; its acked hash is never updated here (only a human `source ack` does that).

source_set_hash.description: Source-set hash after this call; it changes when created is true.
